title: Guard with an early return
prompt: Dividing by zero is an error; run the starter to see it. safe_divide gives -1 when b is 0, and the whole-number result of a divided by b otherwise.
starter:
func safe_divide(a, b):
	return a / b
hints: An if on b with a return inside stops the function early; the normal division comes after it.
The division line stays after the if; it only runs when b is not 0.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
Comparisons. Each gives true or false.
